notes:
• Budget now sits right after Home in the bottom bar, and Wealth takes its old place: Home, Budget, add, Wealth, Activity.

• Every main page has the same three buttons at the top: hide amounts, download the monthly report, and Settings. Hiding amounts on one page hides them everywhere.

• On the Wealth overview, the net worth trend has moved to the bottom of the page, so your balance and accounts come first.

• Delete all my data is no longer in Settings. To erase everything from this phone, uninstall the app or clear its storage in Android settings. The optional wipe after 10 wrong PINs stays.

Already on an older version? Open Settings, then App updates, to install this one. Your data stays. A backup made on 0.2.25 or newer cannot be restored on an older version.
